preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 10**4
preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:2*t+1:2] if line.strip()) and all(len(line.split()) == 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:2*t+1:2] if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with a line containing n (2 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5), followed by a line of n integers a_i (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^6).
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2·10^5.

postconditions.description: For each test case, output the maximum possible number of edges in a graph with n vertices and altitudes a, where no three distinct vertices u, v, w exist such that a_u ≤ a_v ≤ a_w and edges (u,v) and (v,w) exist.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(output) <= n*(n-1)//2 for output in stdout.strip().split())
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a non-negative integer not exceeding the maximum possible edges in a simple undirected graph with n vertices (n*(n-1)/2).
